records.name: MusiCoLab
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that helps local writers and composers build new musicals, with showcases and readings that audiences can attend.
records.what_you_do: Audiences can join the mailing list and attend showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series. Writers and composers can look at the site's Submissions page to send in their work. Feedback is also collected through a page on the site.

schedule.text: Showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series are announced on the site, but the page shows no dates.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list on musicolab.org to hear about the next showcase, or use the Submissions page if you write musicals or songs.
first_step.basis: Showcases are open to audiences and the site gives a clear sign-up and submission path, though no dates are posted.

records.notes: Batch address 1721 S 13th St comes from IRS and Cultural Fund lead data and is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The contact page has only a form, with no email or phone. No dated events were found; '2025 Workshop Red & Black' is named by year only, so the status is probably_active rather than active. Musical theater development has no exact tag in the vocabulary, so only the theater family is set.

records.name: Nichole Canuso Dance Company
records.summary: A Philadelphia dance company that makes and performs new work, and offers movement workshops for community members, dancers and students.
records.what_you_do: Attend a performance such as Lunar Retreat, or join a community movement workshop when one is offered. The company also brings workshops and lecture demonstrations to schools and community groups on request, and holds talks after its performances.

schedule.text: Lunar Retreat premiered September 9 to 20, 2026 as part of the FringeArts Festival (one page says the run ends September 22). Community workshops were held in spring 2026 at Dornsife Community Center. No upcoming workshop dates are listed.

cost.text: Ticket and workshop prices are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Email Kat Moran, the company manager, at kat@nicholecanusodance.org to ask about the next community workshop, or buy a ticket to the next performance.
first_step.basis: A community workshop was listed with times and a venue, and the company gives a booking contact, though no current workshop is shown.

records.notes: Batch address '1413' is incomplete and is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The homepage gives Lunar Retreat an end date of Sept 20 in one place and Sept 22 in another. The company's public address is not on the site. The March 31, 2026 workshop was for blind and low-vision participants, and it has passed.

records.name: Philadelphia Stories
records.summary: A nonprofit that publishes a free literary magazine every quarter and runs writing masterclasses, contests and readings for writers and readers in the Philadelphia area.
records.what_you_do: Read the free magazine or sign up for the newsletter. Writers who live in or come from Pennsylvania, Delaware or New Jersey can submit fiction, poetry, nonfiction or art. You can also take a paid masterclass in novel writing or poetry. A pitch event called Pitch Fest is planned for 2027.

schedule.text: Masterclass dates are not shown on the site, and the events list says 'coming soon.' Pitch Fest is planned for 2027 with no dates yet.

cost.text: Masterclasses are sold through ticket links, and prices are not shown on the page. The magazine itself is free.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on philadelphiastories.org, and read the submission guidelines before you send a piece if you live in or come from Pennsylvania, Delaware or New Jersey.
first_step.basis: Reading, subscribing and submitting are open to anyone in the region through a clear route, though masterclasses are paid and their dates are not posted.

records.notes: Batch address '2021 S 11th Stret' has a typo and does not appear on the site, so no location is recorded. The May 2026 date for the Winter/Spring 2026 issue comes from the file path, since the page prints no month. The /events page returned 404. The /contact page gives no address, email or phone.

records.name: PhilHarmonia
records.summary: A Philadelphia choir of mixed voices, founded in 2013, that sings classical and modern a cappella music and gives concerts, some of them free.
records.what_you_do: Attend a concert, some of which are free. Singers join the choir through an audition, and the next auditions are planned for August 2027. You can join the mailing list, sign up for the audition list, or donate.

schedule.text: Free fall concert on Nov 7, 2026 (two shows, at 1:30 and 3:30 pm, Free Library of Philadelphia, Parkway Central). Winter concert Dec 18, 2026 at 8 pm and a Feb 20, 2027 concert at 8 pm, both at the German Society of Pennsylvania. Spring concert May 8, 2027, time and place to be set. Auditions planned for August 2027.

locations.label: Mailing address (also listed for mailed checks)

cost.text: Some concerts are free. Ticket prices for the others are not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Go to the free fall concert on Nov 7, 2026 at the Free Library's Parkway Central branch, or join the mailing list on philharmoniasings.com to get the audition details if you sing.
first_step.basis: Concerts are open to hear, but joining the choir takes an audition, which is planned for August 2027.

records.notes: Batch address matches the mailing address on the site. The site's footer year 2025 is not counted as evidence. The Oct 3, 2026 fundraiser has already passed. The audition outline on the site includes scales, a tonal memory exercise, sight-singing and an unaccompanied solo. The page gives no phone number.

records.name: Tango Therapy Project
records.summary: A group that teaches adapted Argentine tango to people with Parkinson's, stroke survivors and others with movement or neurological conditions, and trains volunteers to dance with them.
records.what_you_do: Join a tango series as a dancer, with a care partner if you like. Or volunteer as a tango dancer or movement practitioner after a training, and help during the classes.

schedule.text: Center City 10-week series: Wednesdays, Sept 16 to Nov 18, 2026, 10:30 am to 12 pm (already under way). Cherry Hill, NJ 8-week series: Saturdays, 12:30 to 2 pm, Oct 10 to Nov 28, 2026. Volunteer training: Sunday, Oct 18, 2026, 1:30 to 4 pm, at Center in the Park.

locations.label: Center City class site (First Presbyterian Church)
Cherry Hill class site (Katz JCC)
locations.address: 1301 Springdale Rd, Cherry Hill Township, NJ

first_step.how: Email hello@tangotherapyproject.org to ask about joining the Cherry Hill series (starts Oct 10) or the next Center City series, or to sign up for the volunteer training on Sunday, Oct 18, 2026.
first_step.basis: The series are for people with Parkinson's and related conditions. The page does not say how to register or whether someone can join a series already under way.

records.notes: Cost is not on the homepage, and the /classes page returned 404. The Center City ZIP is split on the page, so no ZIP is recorded for that site. The Cherry Hill series is in New Jersey. The most recent news item on the site is a press article dated March 2026. The site also lists a Spring 2025 fundraiser.

records.name: Team Sunshine Performance
records.summary: A Philadelphia performance group that runs theater and movement workshops for students, a youth series about hope and the future, and internships for city high school seniors.
records.what_you_do: Schools and after-school programs book theater and dance workshops for their students, from one session to a full semester. Students can join the Active Hope youth series. Philadelphia high school seniors can ask about an internship, though the current summer deadline has passed.

schedule.text: Workshops are booked by arrangement and can run from one session to a semester. No dates are posted for the Active Hope series, and the summer internship deadline has passed.

cost.text: Prices are not listed on the site. Ask the education team.

first_step.how: Email education@teamsunshineperformance.com to book a workshop for your class or youth group, or to ask about an internship.
first_step.basis: Workshops are arranged through the education team by email, and the page shows no open sign-up for individuals.

records.notes: The site shows no dated news or events. The only date on the homepage is a 2025 copyright line, which does not count. Workshops take place at partner sites, so no public meeting place is listed. The general contact address on the site is captains@teamsunshineperformance.com. The Accessibility and Our Work pages were not read.

records.name: A Book a Day
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that gives books to children and families, runs family events and a mobile clinic, and runs a children's writing and illustration program.
records.what_you_do: Come to an open family event such as Children's Day or the Freedom to Learn fundraiser, or visit an exhibit at The Study. Volunteers can help on service days. Kids can enter the Philly Writers contests when one is open, though none was open when this was checked.

schedule.text: Children's Day was Aug 22, 2026 at Parkway Central Library. The Voices Alive! exhibit ran Sept 11 to 21, 2026 at The Study at University City. The Freedom to Learn fundraiser is Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm, at The Study.

cost.text: Prices for the fundraiser and other open events are not stated.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on abookadayprogram.com, then come to the Freedom to Learn fundraiser at The Study on Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm.
first_step.basis: Open events are listed with dates and places, and a newsletter sign-up is offered, so a newcomer can attend without a prior connection.

records.notes: Batch address matches the site. The Philly Writers page gives no dates, ages or sign-up steps. The Jan 19, 2026 MLK Day of Service has passed. The homepage lists a book review published Sept 29, 2026, with a separate update date of Aug 16, 2026. The contact page was not read.

records.name: Al-Bustan Seeds of Culture
records.summary: A Philadelphia arts and language organization rooted in Arab culture. It offers Arabic classes, art and film events, and arts programs for students.
records.what_you_do: Take an Arabic class (for adults and kids, in person or online), join the monthly Second Thursday open gallery, or come to film screenings, workshops (such as Tatreez embroidery and Know Your Rights sessions) and talks. Students can join the after-school or in-school arts programs, and adults can sign up to volunteer.

schedule.text: Second Thursday open gallery, 6 to 8 pm (next on Nov 12, 2026). Other events are dated on the events page, including film screenings, a Tatreez workshop series and Know Your Rights sessions. Arabic class times are not shown.

cost.text: Prices and sign-up steps are not shown on the events page.

first_step.how: Come to the open gallery on Thursday, Nov 12, 2026, from 6 to 8 pm at 310 Master St, or email info@albustanseeds.org to ask about the next Arabic class.
first_step.basis: The gallery nights are listed as open events with no sign-up shown, and contact details are published for class questions.

records.notes: The batch address 3645 Lancaster Avenue 1 is out of date. The site gives 310 Master St Unit 2, which is used here. Office hours are Tuesday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm. Class times and prices are not on the site. The topic of the Know Your Rights sessions is not described. Cinema Etcetera and the Pageant venue appear on the calendar but were not checked.

records.name: Beyond the Bars
records.summary: A nonprofit that uses music to help Philadelphia youth build skills and confidence, running music labs at schools, shelters and community sites.
records.what_you_do: Young people can sign up for music lessons (bass, drums, guitar, piano or recording) or join a youth program such as the Practical Producers Program, the Student Driven Music Academy or the Student Teacher Program. Adults can volunteer or donate, and the public can attend student performances and youth music showcases.

schedule.text: Music labs and lessons run at school and community sites. The site shows no dates or times for classes or performances.

first_step.how: Students can fill out the Student Sign Up form on the website. A parent, teacher or site leader can ask about a music lab at a school or community site.
first_step.basis: The sign-up pages are public and aimed at young people, but the site where a lab runs decides who can join.

records.notes: The site has no dated news or events. The only dated item is the Impact Report 2024 to 25, which covers a program year. The batch address 3500 Lancaster Ave is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The site publishes no email or phone, and its contact page is a form only. The social media icons have no URLs in the page text. Mostly a youth program, so adults are not the main audience.

records.name: Curio Theatre Company
records.summary: A professional theater company in West Philadelphia that has been staging plays since 2005. It also runs CuriosiTeens!, a free company for local teens.
records.what_you_do: Teens aged 13 to 17 can join CuriosiTeens! for free and learn theater on Saturday mornings. Adults can see the season, buy a subscription package, join the mailing list, or give to the spotlight fund.

schedule.text: CuriosiTeens! meets every Saturday, 10 am to noon. The Season 22 (2026 to 2027) performance dates are not shown on the site.

locations.label: CuriosiTeens! meeting place (Calvary Center for Culture and Community, enter by the side door on 48th Street)

cost.text: CuriosiTeens! is free. Ticket prices for shows are not shown.

first_step.how: Call 215-921-8243, or email the address on the CuriosiTeens! page, to ask about joining a Saturday session (ages 13 to 17).
first_step.basis: The teen company is open to local teens through a published phone number and email, and no formal application is described.

records.notes: Batch address 815 S 48th St is not shown on the site. The CuriosiTeens! page gives 4740 Baltimore Ave as the meeting place, which is recorded here. That page is internally inconsistent: it mentions a full production in June 2024 and also a 2026 play. Teens who are 12 may be accepted case by case. The active status rests on the 2026 to 2027 season label, which has no month. The email address is hidden on the page.

records.name: Dance Iquail!
records.summary: An arts group that turns residents' own life stories into dance and percussion work, with a yearly community festival in Mantua and a long-running youth dance program there.
records.what_you_do: Mantua youth can join the percussive dance program Mantua's Most Majestic. The group also offers classes, holds auditions for its productions, has a volunteer page, and runs the Celebrate Mantua festival, which the site says drew over 2,500 people in 2023.

schedule.text: The site lists no upcoming events. Celebrate Mantua is described as a one-day annual festival, and the youth program runs for 50 weeks.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list on danceiquail.org, then check the Classes page for the next class.
first_step.basis: Classes and auditions appear on the site only by name, with no dates, prices or sign-up steps, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The only dated item found is a 2023 figure for Celebrate Mantua attendance. The site also says 'No Upcoming Events.' The footer year 2026 is not evidence. Status is unknown rather than dormant, because the site could still be active without showing dates. Mantua's Most Majestic is for Mantua youth. The batch address 3500 Lancaster Ave is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The Auditions and Contact pages were not read.

records.name: District One Community Education Center
records.summary: An arts space at 3500 Lancaster Ave where artists rehearse, teach and perform. It runs weekly dance classes open to the community and rents space to artists and tenant groups.
records.what_you_do: Take a dance class at ECR Studio: Funk Sole Fundamentals on Wednesday evenings, a Friday night workshop with Group Motion, Kulu Mele dance on the first Thursday, or West African dance on the first Saturday. Check the Upcoming Events page for performances.

schedule.text: Funk Sole Fundamentals: Wednesdays, 6 to 8 pm. Kulu Mele dance: Thursdays at 7 pm, on the first Thursday of the month. Friday night workshop with Group Motion: Fridays at 8 pm. West African dance with Angela Watson: Saturdays at 2 pm, on the first Saturday of the month. No performance dates are listed.

cost.text: Each class is marked with a dollar sign on the site. Amounts are not shown.

first_step.how: Pick a class on the Classes page, then call 215.387.1911 or email Programs@cecarts.org to ask about sign-up and prices before the first session.
first_step.basis: Classes are listed with days and times, but the page does not say how to sign up or whether drop-ins are welcome.

records.notes: Batch name is District One Community Education Center. The site calls it Community Education Center (CEC). The batch address matches the site. The footer reads 2023, which is not evidence. No dated events were found, so the status rests on the recurring class listings. The Rentals, Programs and Tenant Organizations pages were not read.

records.name: Love Now Media
records.summary: A media and storytelling group whose Love Lab hosts public events on art, dialogue and AI education, and whose Poet's Press publishes poetry and commentary.
records.what_you_do: Reserve a spot at a Love Lab event or a Poet's Press writing workshop. Poets can send in work through the Poet's Press submission form. Anyone can join the mailing list or take out a magazine subscription, and some partner events are sold as tickets.

schedule.text: Events are posted one at a time, each with its own reserve link. The homepage shows a post dated Oct 2, 2026, and no event times are shown on the homepage.

cost.text: Some events are ticketed. Prices are not shown on the homepage.

first_step.how: Choose a Love Lab event on lovenowmedia.com and use its reserve-your-spot link, or sign up for the mailing list to hear about the next Poet's Press workshop.
first_step.basis: Events and workshops are public and use a clear reserve link, so a newcomer can join without a prior connection.

records.notes: Batch address matches the site. The John Graves Partnership event (ticketed) is named as a partner but was not checked. People's Media Fund is named as a funder and is not recorded. The site shows no email or phone.

records.name: Ollin Yoliztli Calmecac
records.summary: A Philadelphia group founded in 2003 to explore and share Mexicayotl culture, a tradition from Mexico before the Spanish arrived. It runs events, a radio show and an Indigenous Peoples Day celebration.
records.what_you_do: Attend the group's events and programs, such as the 14th Philadelphia Indigenous People Day, or follow the Nika Tlaka radio show. The site has pages for volunteers and members, but they do not yet show steps, terms or fees. You can also read the blog and history pages, or donate.

schedule.text: The homepage shows no dates or times for its events. The events page was blocked (HTTP 403) and could not be read.

cost.text: Membership fees and event prices are not shown.

first_step.how: Email brujo@ollinyoliztlicalmecac.org to ask how to volunteer or join as a member, and ask about the next event.
first_step.basis: Volunteer and member pages exist, but no steps, terms or fees are shown, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The events page (/events) returned HTTP 403 and was not retried; it is listed under blocked. Status is probably_active only because the site works, with no dated item found. The copyright year 2026 is not counted. The batch address 2062 S Cecil St is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. Social links were not shown.

records.name: Original American Foundation
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that aims to help low-income American Indian and people of color households become more self-sufficient, with gardening and home repair help.
records.what_you_do: Request a consultation on home or community gardening, or on home repair and renovation, through the website. You can also order homemade smoothies for pickup by phone, or donate through GoFundMe or Cash App. Gallery photos show past garden and community-building workshops from 2023 and 2024.

schedule.text: No dates are shown on the site. The only dated items are a 2024 garden workshop and 2023 workshop photos, both given by year only.

cost.text: Not stated whether consultations cost money.

first_step.how: Email originalamericanfoundation@protonmail.com to request a gardening or home repair consultation.
first_step.basis: The site offers consultation requests, but shows no class, membership or volunteer steps and no dates for workshops, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site has no street address. The batch address 532 S 57th St is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The phone number is published for smoothie orders. The footer's 2021 copyright is not evidence. The newest dated item is a 2024 workshop, given by year only, so the status is unknown rather than dormant. The donation pages (GoFundMe, Cash App) are not recorded as contacts.

records.name: Unnamed Film Festival INC
records.summary: A film festival listed as a Philadelphia Cultural Fund grantee. Its own website did not show what it does during this check.
records.what_you_do: Unknown. The group's site loaded only its name, so attending or other roles could not be checked.

first_step.how: Visit phillyunnamed.net later to see whether events or calls for films are listed, since the site did not show its content in this check.

records.notes: The homepage at phillyunnamed.net returned only the site name, with no text, dates or contacts, so there is nothing to verify. The /about page returned HTTP 403 and was not retried; it is listed under blocked. The category is based on the name alone. The name and grantee status come from the Cultural Fund grantee lead in the batch file, and the directory page was not re-opened in this check.

records.name: Journey Arts
records.what_you_do: Attend a Table Sessions performance, a show with a chef-made meal and audience conversation, or donate. The site lists no classes, workshops, memberships or volunteer roles.
records.notes: Verdict reason (provisional): the only public role found is attending performances and donating, which fits the rule for a company whose public role is buying a ticket. The homepage names an Intercultural Journeys program, but the page for it returned HTTP 404 and the /programs page also returned 404, so it could not be checked. Recheck before the verdict is final. The next season was tentatively planned for spring 2026 with no dates, and the latest dated event is June 2025. Past venues such as Bartram's Garden were not checked.

records.name: Philadelphia Chamber Ensemble
records.what_you_do: Attend a concert (tickets are sold through the site) or buy one of its CDs. The site lists no classes, workshops, open rehearsals, memberships, volunteer roles or community programs.
records.notes: Verdict reason: the only public role found is buying concert tickets and CDs. The 49th season (2026 to 2027) has fall concerts on Oct 9 and 11, winter on Feb 12 and 14, and spring on Apr 30 and May 2. The page does not print years for the individual dates. Music At Home is a list of recordings for sale, not a listening or community program. Recheck if a community program appears on the site.

notes: Verdicts: 16 publish, 2 not_a_group. Searches used: 0 (none allowed). Fetches used: 40 of 60. Pages returning 404 (not blocks, not retried): philadelphiastories.org/events, tangotherapyproject.org/classes, journeyarts.org/intercultural-journeys, journeyarts.org/programs. Curio's funder logo links to babawestphilly.org, which redirects to babamag.com, the publication of the Baltimore Avenue Business Association. A business association is out of scope, so it was not added. Places that appear in pages but are not groups and were not checked: Dornsife Community Center (Nichole Canuso workshop venue), Pageant (Al-Bustan venue), Trinity Center for Urban Life and Bartram's Garden (past Journey Arts venues). Batch addresses that the sites did not confirm, so no location was recorded: 1721 S 13th St (MusiCoLab), 1413 (Nichole Canuso, incomplete), 2021 S 11th Stret (Philadelphia Stories, typo), 3500 Lancaster Ave (Beyond the Bars and Dance Iquail, not on site), 2062 S Cecil St (Ollin), 532 S 57th St (Original American Foundation), 815 S 48th St (Curio). The Al-Bustan batch address was out of date and was replaced with the published address. Copyright footers were not counted as evidence. No leads were found that had a checkable website.
